questions.question: Unit tests pass, but a poison prompt stalls the tokenizer and a provider hiccup cascades through retries. How do you find such failures first?
options: More unit tests of the same kind
Controlled chaos against staging with SLOs and a kill switch
questions.explanation: Unit tests cannot show emergent production modes. This lesson breaks them on purpose, with guardrails, before users do.

questions.question: Why is provider 429 fallback aborted by the safety plane?
options: Its error rate is below the expected baseline
It has no blast radius at all
questions.explanation: 0.015 / 0.0005 = 30×, and both burn_rate > 2.0 and blast_radius_pct > 0.2 are true, so paused_by_safety_plane is true.

questions.question: Why does the pod-kill experiment complete despite a 4× burn rate?
options: The burn rate is calculated as zero
Pod kills are excluded from the experiment list
The error budget is disabled for five-minute tests
questions.explanation: The pod kill has 0.002/0.0005 = 4×, but the pause condition requires both high burn and blast radius above 0.2; 0.05 fails the second test.

questions.question: What exact conjunction triggers paused_by_safety_plane?
questions.explanation: run_experiment sets paused only when both the burn-rate and blast-radius comparisons are true.

questions.question: What happens to malformed prompt tokenizer stall in the supplied experiment list?
options: It is always promoted to production
It is skipped before burn rate is calculated
It is aborted because every error rate above 1% is forbidden
questions.explanation: Its 4% rate is 80× expected, but the blast radius is 10%; the conjunction is false, so the local status is COMPLETED.

questions.question: Which status string is returned for an experiment stopped by the guard?
questions.explanation: run_experiment maps paused_by_safety_plane to ABORTED (burn-rate guard); non-paused experiments return COMPLETED.
